IRON YARD — authorized one-shot update of the EXISTING PUBLIC Roblox FPS.

Merged PR #49, source a872febdb6191c97e86dd73a3fa7a70f5695257e.
Server-side CombatAwards now grants at most ONE victory per player
per round, even if a round-finalization callback runs repeatedly.
The claim happens before XP, progression storage and feedback. The
guard resets at the next round only. Other players are independent.

New pure Luau test exercises 10,000 duplicate callbacks and 1,000
round resets; a Python integration contract checks the live call order.
Branch CI, PR CI and merged main Rojo CI are all green.

Require a NEW green Rojo CI on this authorization commit before any
one-shot publish. Verify existing owner, PUBLIC universe and original
place independently. Do not create a new experience or private alpha.
No claim of real in-engine testing is made by these offline tests.
